# T-1: Model review convergence values

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Introduce the dedicated class model for review dispositions, tooling outcomes, evidence identities, canonical evidence, attempt state, and permitted operations.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Constructors enforce disposition/finding consistency, phase/task/tree/provenance identity, bounded finding content, and permitted-operation payload exclusivity.
- Canonical serialization produces a stable SHA-256 evidence digest and rejects caller-supplied identity overrides.
- Legacy FAIL and TOOLING_FAILURE are absent from the new disposition model.

## Implementation Notes
Use a deep review-convergence module and dedicated subclasses or classes for meaningful operation variants. Reuse existing StepOutcome concepts only where their invariants match; do not encode domain variants as object literal unions.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local unit tests cover valid/invalid constructors, canonical digest stability, size/count bounds, and operation payload invariants.
